address: Killellan Farm, Toward, Dunoon, Argyll and Bute

site_area_m2.claimant: Argyll Data Development Ltd (184 acres / 74 ha); APRS says 186 acres
site_area_m2.notes: Developer 'currently holds access to approximately 184 acres within this designated area'; remainder owned by 'a high-net-worth individual'. Bid says full build-out could extend to 400 acres of infrastructure.

current_land_use: Working sand and gravel quarry (~20 ha, operated by Cowal Sand and Gravel Ltd since 2006) plus farmland at Killellan Farm
previous_land_use: Farmland and quarrying; press links the wider area to the former Ardyne Point oil-rig construction yard near Toward
land_notes: Coordinates are an approximate placement of Killellan Farm/quarry area between Toward and Ardyne, from OSM features; no red-line boundary has been published, so no boundary.geojson is provided. Site access stated as via the Killellan Farm entrance from the A815. Developer describes the site as 'industrially zoned'; APRS describes it as brownfield and farmland. Note the place-name: council and developer records use 'Killellan' (Toward, Cowal); 'Killean' is a different settlement in Kintyre — APRS's use of 'Killean' is a variant/erroneous spelling.
